envelope.description: Fake gh fixture, parser check and cross-cutting tests

body.title: Fake gh fixture, parser check and cross-cutting tests
body.summary: Add the fake gh binary fixture and only the cross-cutting tests that need it or the installed gh: the real-CLI parser check with the canary, approval request display and masking, timeouts, failure mapping through real calls, output schema checks and search expression tests; per-task unit tests stay in their own tasks.
acceptanceChecks: every op's argv with --help as its own final token parses against the installed gh and the canary prints help with no request
a fake gh that outlives its limit ends with a timed-out message naming the command and the limit
secretValue is masked and ssh-key text longer than 2000 characters shows exactly its first 2000 characters and the length

tests.name: gh-parser.test.ts: every op's argv with --help as its own final token parses against the installed gh under an empty HOME, no token and a closed-port proxy, and the gh issue delete 1 --help canary makes no request

gh-approval.test.ts: secretValue masked, key text up to 2000 characters shown whole, a longer key shown as its first 2000 characters and the length, keyFile shows only the path, codespace create preview states the permissions are accepted, a declined destructive call does not run gh

gh-timeouts.test.ts: a fake gh that outlives its limit ends with timed-out naming the command and the limit, a mutating time-out adds that the outcome is unknown, and no ghExec call outside the table passes its own timeout
gh-failures.test.ts: a fake gh that closes its stdin early gives a stdin error that is a failure even at exit 0
gh-output-schemas.test.ts: every output of a family tool carries the literal op and validates for success and failure
gh-live.test.ts: gh_auth status, gh_config list, gh_search repos with limit 1, gh_gist list columns and a bad token giving missing-signin (INSRC_LIVE_TESTS=1)
